spanish: Si desde año del yovel santificare su campo, conforme a tu valoración se levantará.

findings.issue: הַיֹּבֵל is a common noun with the article (H3104), not a name; “yovel” leaves the lemma untranslated instead of Spanish.
Hiphil imperfect 3ms is archaic future subjunctive “santificare”, the same form as 1s, so person is not uniquely 3ms.

notes: Si, desde-año construct, su campo, conforme a tu valoración, and qal 3ms se levantará match the other tokens.
